dhpak2.6:2.2: jetavane viharanto dve sahāyake bhikkhū ārabbha kathesi.
dhpak2.6:3.1: Te kira satthu santike kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā āraññakavihāraṃ pavisiṃsu.
dhpak2.6:3.2: Tesu eko kira kālasseva dārūni āharitvā aṅgārakapallaṃ sajjetvā
dhpak2.6:3.3: daharasāmaṇerehi saddhiṃ sallapanto paṭhamayāmaṃ visibbamāno nisīdati.
dhpak2.6:3.4: Eko appamatto samaṇadhammaṃ karonto itaraṃ ovadati,
dhpak2.6:3.5: “āvuso, mā evaṃ kari, pamattassa hi cattāro apāyā sakagharasadisā.
dhpak2.6:3.6: Buddhā nāma sāṭheyyena ārādhetuṃ na sakkā”ti
dhpak2.6:4.5: kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā uṭṭhāya samaṇadhammaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭatī”ti
dhpak2.6:4.6: vatvā attano vasanaṭṭhānaṃ pavisitvā nipajjitvā supati.
dhpak2.6:4.9: So evaṃ appamatto viharanto na cirasseva saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.
dhpak2.6:5.5: kacci vo pabbajitakiccaṃ matthakaṃ patta”nti pucchi.
dhpak2.6:5.6: Paṭhamaṃ pamatto bhikkhu āha – “kuto, bhante, etassa appamādo,
dhpak2.6:5.7: gatakālato paṭṭhāya nipajjitvā niddāyanto kālaṃ vītināmesī”ti.
dhpak2.6:5.9: “Ahaṃ, bhante, kālasseva dārūni āharitvā aṅgārakapallaṃ sajjetvā
dhpak2.6:5.10: paṭhamayāme visibbento nisīditvā aniddāyantova kālaṃ vītināmesi”nti.
dhpak2.6:6.1: Atha naṃ satthā “tvaṃ pamatto kālaṃ vītināmetvā
dhpak2.6:6.2: ‘appamattomhī’ti vadasi, appamattaṃ pana pamattaṃ karosī”ti āha.
dhpak2.6:7.1: Puna pamāde dose, appamāde ānisaṃse pakāsetuṃ,
dhpak2.6:8.1: “tvaṃ mama puttassa santike javacchinno dubbalasso viya, esa
dhpak2.6:8.2: pana tava santike sīghajavasso viyā”ti vatvā imaṃ gāthamāha –
dhpak2.6:10.1: Tattha appamattoti sativepullappattatāya appamādasampanne khīṇāsavo. Pamattesūti sativosagge ṭhitesu sattesu. Suttesūti
dhpak2.6:10.2: satijāgariyābhāvena sabbiriyāpathesu niddāyantesu. Bahujāgaroti mahante sativepulle jāgariye ṭhito. Abalassaṃvāti
dhpak2.6:10.3: kuṇṭhapādaṃ chinnajavaṃ dubbalassaṃ sīghajavo sindhavājānīyo viya. Sumedhasoti uttamapañño. Tathārūpaṃ puggalaṃ āgamenapi
dhpak2.6:10.4: adhigamenapi hitvā yāti. Mandapaññasmiñhi ekaṃ suttaṃ gahetuṃ vāyamanteyeva sumedhaso ekaṃ vaggaṃ gaṇhāti, evaṃ tāva
dhpak2.6:10.5: āgamena hitvā yāti. Mandapaññe pana rattiṭṭhānadivāṭṭhānāni kātuṃ vāyamanteyeva kammaṭṭhānaṃ uggahetvā sajjhāyanteyeva ca
dhpak2.6:10.6: sumedhaso pubbabhāgepi parena kataṃ rattiṭṭhānaṃ vā divāṭṭhānaṃ vā pavisitvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ sammasanto sabbakilese khepetvā
dhpak2.6:10.7: neva lokuttaradhamme hatthagate karoti, evaṃ adhigamenapi hitvā yāti. Vaṭṭe pana naṃ hitvā chaḍḍetvā vaṭṭato nissaranto yātiyevāti.
